key_insight: Laser surface texturing greatly prolongs MoS2 lubricant life on 6082-T6 aluminium, with higher groove density and pin-on-disc texturing on both surfaces giving the best tribological durability.
engineering_relevance: The results provide a practical route to improve wear resistance and reduce relubrication needs for lightweight aluminium components in sliding-contact applications.
method: Fabricated groove textures with 25–100% texture density using an infrared nanosecond fibre laser
Applied MoS2 coatings by spraying to 6082-T6 aluminium
Tested dry and lubricated wear in textured-pin, textured-disc, and dual-textured pin-on-disc configurations; complemented with finite element analysis
evidence_signal: Laser texturing extended MoS2 service life by about 2 to 50 times versus non-textured surfaces, with the longest life in the pin-and-disc textured setup.
watch_item: Performance depends strongly on texture density and contact configuration, so the same design may not transfer directly without re-optimization for load, geometry, and duty cycle.
paper_title: Tribological Performance of MoS2-Coated 6082-T6 Aluminium: Influence of Laser Texture Density and Pin-on-Disc Test Configuration
